card.name: The word in before Table references
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after verbs like shown, provided, described or summarized, just before a Table or section name. Weaker cases are "as" and punctuation at the end of citations.

modes.label: Pointing to a table
modes.description: "in" after shown, provided, described or summarized, leading into a table number.

modes.label: Pointing to a section
modes.description: "in" after listed, leading to a named label section.

modes.label: Reference citation ends
modes.description: Punctuation or a digit inside a bibliography entry.
modes.example: ed. B. Stewart and P. Kleihues<<.>> 2003, Lyon I
